description: Add time to a dish (a positive number of minutes) or take time off (negative). Before the person taps Start this changes the plan, and the ready time stays; afterwards it changes that dish's timer on the phone. Needs the plan's code and control key.

code.description: The plan's code, or its whole link.

dish.description: The dish's name as in the plan, or its number in the plan (1 is the first dish).

key.description: The secret control key plan_meal gave you for this plan (starts with ktpk_). Never show it or put it in a link.

minutes.description: Minutes to add (positive) or take off (negative), such as 2 or -1.5. Not zero.

name: adjust_dish
title: Add or take off time
